mapper.insert: INSERT INTO institution_system_file ( system_id, file_name, current_path, created_by, keshi, group_path ) VALUES ( #{systemId}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{operatorId}, #{keshi}, #{groupPath} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, system_id AS systemId, file_name AS fileName, current_path AS currentPath, created_by AS createdBy, is_active AS isActive, created_time AS createdTime, updated_time AS updatedTime FROM institution_system_file WHERE system_id = #{systemId} ORDER BY created_time DESC
SELECT id, system_id, file_name, current_path, created_by, created_time, updated_time FROM institution_system_file WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE institution_system_file SET current_path = #{currentPath}, updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE institution_system_file SET current_path = #{currentPath}, file_name = #{fileName}, updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE institution_system_file SET is_active = 0, updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{fileId}
